design:
Part of the dwsim-libs maturity epic (bn op-otqe).

Find **independent reference problems**. The converged synthetic crude column
is evidence the solver runs, not evidence it is right.

## Thermodynamics

Flash and property calculations against published or trusted reference values,
for each supported property package.

**Pay particular attention to cubic-EOS root selection.** This workspace has
already been bitten by exactly this: `select_root` accepted `Z <= B`, which
put a non-positive argument into `ln(Z - B)`, produced `NaN`, and returned
`Some(NaN)` where it should have returned `None`. The failure surfaced far
downstream as a bubble-point that would not converge.

Root-selection defects are quiet — they produce a number, not an error — so
this deserves explicit test coverage at the boundary rather than confidence
that it was fixed once.

Note also that the sibling `tampines-steam-tables` crate carries `#[ignore]`d
Peng-Robinson tests reporting **7%, 17% and 26% error vs NIST**, flagged as
possible root-selection or formula bugs (#62). That is a different code path in
a different crate and is out of scope there, but if the same formulation was
ported to both, it is worth checking whether the defect travelled.

## Column solver

Use a **published or independently reproducible rigorous distillation
benchmark** with known stage profiles, compositions and duties.

Verify: mass balance; component balances; **energy balance**; stage
temperatures; compositions; condenser duty; reboiler duty; convergence
behaviour.

Energy balance matters most here and is the easiest to omit — a column can
close mass perfectly while getting duties wrong.

## Crude characterization

Compare pseudo-component properties and cut behaviour against a **documented
petroleum assay** where possible.

## The standard to hold

**Do not claim validation against a real refinery merely because the synthetic
crude column converges.** Convergence, material balance and predictive accuracy
are three separate claims, and only the first two are currently demonstrated.

Each validated axis feeds the corresponding evidence class in the maturity
declaration; axes that cannot be validated yet stay recorded as unvalidated
rather than being quietly upgraded.
title: dwsim-libs: independent validation of thermodynamics, column numerics and characterization

acceptance_criteria: LHS verified one point per equiprobable stratum per variable with correct marginals; grid verified exact tensor product (count + coordinates); Monte Carlo verified moment convergence at 1/sqrt(N) and bit-for-bit reproducibility from a fixed seed. Methodology AND measured numbers with date recorded.
description:
Implement crates/raffles/src/samplers.rs. Monte Carlo, Latin hypercube (RAVEN calls it Stratified), grid/full-factorial; optionally factorial and response-surface designs. Owns the RNG and its seeding.

Upstream: ravenframework/Samplers/ (MonteCarlo.py, Stratified.py, Grid.py, FactorialDesign.py, ResponseSurfaceDesign.py) + GridEntities.py.

NOTE: RAVEN's Samplers/Sobol.py is a sparse-grid decomposition for surrogate construction — NOT the Sobol index estimator and NOT the Sobol low-discrepancy sequence. Keep the three apart and say which is which in each file's doc.

Needs an RNG dependency: add it to the ROOT [workspace.dependencies], pure-Rust only (Termux), explicit seeding required.

Enum dispatch (Sampler enum) — no Box<dyn>, no lifetimes. Drop RAVEN's Factory/XML instantiation entirely.

NOT here: distributions, running the model, post-processing, adaptive/model-in-the-loop samplers.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
Implementation + verification landed in crates/raffles/src/samplers.rs (2026-08-06).

DELIVERED: Sampler enum {MonteCarlo, LatinHypercube (RAVEN's 'Stratified'), Grid}, SamplingDesign contract trait, stream_seed(). Output contract is unit uniforms in [0,1) — callers map through distributions::Distribution. Ported from RAVEN devel @ 01216937967c38ee287859270c035c8eca906dc6 with full Apache-2.0 attribution header + translation notes.

RNG: reuses outram_mc_libs::rng::lcg (added as a path dep via [workspace.dependencies]); NO local PRNG, NO rand crate. Explicit master_seed on every generate(); one non-overlapping future_seed stream per dimension.

VERIFIED: cargo check -p raffles --all-targets clean; same for --target aarch64-linux-android; cargo test --release -p raffles = 20 lib tests + 6 doctests, all passing (13 lib + 5 doctests are this module's). LHS stratification exact over 22,416 occupancies; grid tensor product exact; MC error decays at N^-1/2 (measured ratios 3.282 / 2.711 vs 3.162); designs bit-for-bit reproducible.

NOT DONE (deliberate, documented in-module): per-point probability weights, value-space grids, correlated/multivariate designs, factorial + response-surface designs.

BLOCKER FOUND -> filed op-rbo (P1): outram_mc_libs::rng::lcg::init_seed derives streams one LCG step apart, not one stride apart, diverging from OpenMC. Worked around here by calling future_seed directly.

Status left open for maintainer/owner sign-off — the V&V and human-interface axes are human-review axes.

description:
Found 2026-07-28 while cross-compiling release assets. ciet_educational_simulator_v2 carries #![cfg_attr(not(debug_assertions), windows_subsystem = "windows")] inherited from v1, so the Windows exe has NO console attached: --help, --headless and the OPC-UA connection banner print nowhere. ciet_v2_opcua_client has no such attribute, so it is a console-subsystem exe and shows a bare console window behind its GUI.

Maintainer accepted the current state ('good enough') for the 0.2.0 release assets. Options if revisited: (1) leave and document headless as Linux/Termux only; (2) add the attribute to the client so both are GUI-clean (one line, recommended); (3) AttachConsole(ATTACH_PARENT_PROCESS) on Windows so the GUI stays clean AND CLI output works -- correct but needs a Windows-only windows-sys dep and an unsafe block in the bin (the library is #![forbid(unsafe_code)]).

Also note the Windows exes are COMPILE-VERIFIED ONLY -- no wine on the build machine, never launched.
title: Windows exe subsystem mismatch between the two v2 binaries
